title: Clinical Data Exchange
thesis: Snowflake enables secure multi-hospital data sharing with patient-level consent governance via Row Access Policies, AI-powered clinical insights via Cortex Complete, and open Iceberg interoperability — replacing siloed EHRs with governed clinical intelligence

talking_points: Twenty hospitals actively sharing data — 2M patient records with PDPA consent.
Ninety-four percent consent coverage. Six percent of patients have partial or expired consent.
Network handling 50K queries/month from researchers, clinicians, and population health teams.

transition.line: Let's see how the data governance controls work.

talking_points: Row Access Policies enforce PDPA consent at query time — no consented patient data leaks to unauthorized parties.
Column masking hides identifiers from researchers — only clinicians with patient relationship see full names.
Iceberg format enables governed sharing between Snowflake and external research platforms.
tabs.call_out: PDPA enforcement at query time — governance built into the data layer

transition.line: What clinical insights can we generate?

talking_points: Research cohort identification: 4,200 diabetic patients on GLP-1 therapy across the network.
Treatment outcomes: Hospital A knee replacement readmission rate 2σ above network average.
Cortex Complete generates research summary with citations from clinical guidelines.
tabs.call_out: Cohort identification in seconds — outcome benchmarking in real time

transition.line: Now let the CHIO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Kamol asks: 'Which hospitals have outcome variance for cardiac surgery?'
Cortex Analyst: Hospital C 30-day readmission at 8.2% vs network average 4.1%.
Switch to advisor: 'What might explain Hospital C's variance?' — references case mix, surgeon volume, and guidelines.
show: Type: 'Outcome variance by hospital for cardiac surgery'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL clinical analytics + evidence-based advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Lake Formation/Row Access Policies govern access; Iceberg enables interoperability; Cortex Complete generates insights.
Thailand's PDPA (2022) requires explicit consent for health data sharing. This enforces it natively.
tabs.call_out: Governed clinical data sharing — Iceberg + Row Access Policies + AI

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thai health information exchange.
